rationale: Fail: The agent canceled order #W3361211 without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing write. The user’s primary request was to change the luggage set to a coat; the agent did not attempt a change or propose alternatives, nor did it attempt a return before resorting to cancellation. It also did not confirm which order contained the luggage set before acting, despite multiple orders being referenced. While some user lookup steps appear to have been performed, explicit authentication and confirmation are unclear, and the decisive policy breach is executing a cancellation without user confirmation. Even if the refund details are accurate, the action was taken improperly under the stated policy.
